title: mcp: list_actions marks no action unavailable for an AI service account, though run_action refuses its confirmation-gated actions whatever it sends
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvXzthnUYrxzphgFgW

Filing gate: ① a named-site behaviour gap, class b, carried out of #32936 (its acceptance is "No runtime change"; scope addition 6839924935 asked for both a text and a listing change, and PR #33057 delivers the text only). Priority and lane are triage's.

## What is true on `main` (read at `64c426ab`, contract review 6846560754 on PR #33057)

- `listActions` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` sets a row's `unavailable` from `apiForwardCredentialRefusal` alone (lines 1127 and 1148). It never reads the caller's kind.
- A row's `requiresConfirmation` is `actionLooksDestructive` (the declared `ai.requiresConfirmation`, else `mode: 'delete'` or `variant: 'danger'`).
- `run_action`, REST `/actions`, `resume_run` and a host's `dispatchAction` refuse an AI service account (`isAiServiceAccountCaller`: `principalKind === 'agent'`, no `onBehalfOf`) `428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` on an action declaring `ai.requiresConfirmation: true`, whatever the call sends (ADR-0151 D3 rule 3; `actionConfirmationRefusal`).
- The exported JSDoc on `McpActionSummary.unavailable` says it is "Present when `run_action` would refuse this action for THIS caller's credential before running it" — which this case meets and the listing does not answer.

## Business reason

An AI client on a service-account key lists actions, sees a gated action with no `unavailable` marker, calls it and is refused every time. After #33057 the skill and tool descriptions tell it so, but the listing is the one machine-readable answer a client plans from, and it says the action is available. `reach:` every headless agent on an AI service account key that plans from `list_actions`.

## Acceptance

- For a caller `isAiServiceAccountCaller` is true of, a row whose action declares `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` carries `unavailable` (reason naming the account rule, the same sentence family as the runtime's "a person runs this action"); computed from the declared flag, not from `actionLooksDestructive`.
- A person, a delegated agent (`onBehalfOf` set) and the system context see the listing unchanged.
- Pins on both arms (account → marker; delegated agent → no marker) with `code`/shape asserted; changeset on the touched package.

Dedupe: `list_actions unavailable service account`, `listActions unavailable requiresConfirmation` → only #32936 (the text half). **New.**
